# sonarqube_alm_azure (Data Source)

Looks up a Azure DevOps DevOps platform setting. Its secrets are not readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_alm_azure" "main" {
  key = "azure-devops"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the setting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `url` (String) Azure DevOps collection URL.
